179854.name: letm-1
179854.summary: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial calcium ion transmembrane transport and mitochondrion organization. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed widely. Orthologous to several human genes including LETM1 (leucine zipper and EF-hand containing transmembrane protein 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179898.name: aip-1
179898.summary: Predicted to enable zinc ion binding activity. Involved in cellular response to misfolded protein and response to arsenic-containing substance. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including excretory cell; intestine; pharynx; somatic gonad; and tail. Orthologous to human ZFAND2A (zinc finger AN1-type containing 2A) and ZFAND2B (zinc finger AN1-type containing 2B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179899.name: mtl-2
179899.summary: Enables cadmium ion binding activity and zinc ion binding activity. Involved in response to cadmium ion and response to heat. Is expressed in intestinal cell and intestine. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

179922.name: atfs-1
179922.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; enzyme binding activity; and mitochondrial transcription factor activity. Involved in defense response to Gram-negative bacterium; mitochondrial unfolded protein response; and regulation of gene expression. Located in mitochondrial matrix. Colocalizes with nucleus. Is expressed in intestine. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

179945.name: dlat-1
179945.description: Dihydrolipoyllysine-residue acetyltransferase component of pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, mitochondrial
179945.otherdesignations: Dihydrolipoyllysine-residue acetyltransferase component of pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, mitochondrial
179945.nomenclaturename: Dihydrolipoyllysine-residue acetyltransferase component of pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, mitochondrial
179945.summary: Predicted to enable dihydrolipoyllysine-residue acetyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in pyruvate decarboxylation to acetyl-CoA. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial matrix. Predicted to be part of pyruvate dehydrogenase complex. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in several structures, including anal depressor muscle; intestine; nervous system; pharynx; and reproductive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pyruvate decarboxylase deficiency. Orthologous to human DLAT (dihydrolipoamide S-acetyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

179948.name: bmk-1
179948.summary: Predicted to enable plus-end-directed microtubule motor activity. Involved in negative regulation of mitotic spindle elongation. Located in spindle midzone and spindle pole. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in microcephaly with or without chorioretinopathy, lymphedema, or mental retardation. Orthologous to human KIF11 (kinesin family member 11). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179998.name: rps-16
179998.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in maturation of SSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Predicted to be located in ribosome. Predicted to be part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPS16 (ribosomal protein S16). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180014.name: unc-76
180014.summary: Enables syntaxin binding activity. Involved in several processes, including anterograde axonal protein transport; axonal fasciculation; and regulation of axon extension. Located in axon; neuronal cell body; and perinuclear region of cytoplasm. Is expressed in neurons and somatic nervous system. Orthologous to human FEZ1 (fasciculation and elongation protein zeta 1) and FEZ2 (fasciculation and elongation protein zeta 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180049.name: atx-3
180049.summary: Enables cysteine-type deubiquitinase activity. Involved in chemical synaptic transmission. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including coelomocyte; head; hypodermis; reproductive system; and somatic nervous system. Used to study Machado-Joseph disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Machado-Joseph disease and late onset Parkinson's disease. Orthologous to several human genes including ATXN3 (ataxin 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180079.name: cth-1
180079.summary: Predicted to enable cystathionine gamma-lyase activity and pyridoxal phosphate binding activity. Predicted to be involved in L-cysteine biosynthetic process and transsulfuration. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in amino acid metabolic disorder and cystathioninuria. Orthologous to human CTH (cystathionine gamma-lyase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180080.name: argk-1
180080.summary: Predicted to enable kinase activity. Involved in ATP metabolic process and generation of precursor metabolites and energy. Predicted to be active in extracellular region. Is expressed in IL socket cell; OL socket cell; and intestine. Orthologous to several human genes including CKB (creatine kinase B); CKM (creatine kinase, M-type); and CKMT1A (creatine kinase, mitochondrial 1A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180121.name: dkf-2
180121.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including defense response to bacterium; determination of adult lifespan; and phospholipase C-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway. Acts upstream of with a negative effect on protein import into nucleus. Located in cytoplasmic side of plasma membrane and cytosol. Is expressed in intestine; lumbar neurons; neurons; pharynx; and spermathecal-uterine junction. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital heart disease. Orthologous to human PRKD1 (protein kinase D1); PRKD2 (protein kinase D2); and PRKD3 (protein kinase D3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180148.name: skr-5
180148.summary: Predicted to enable cullin family protein binding activity. Predicted to be involved in SCF-dependent proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in hypodermis; intestinal cell; intestine; and vulval muscle. Orthologous to human SKP1 (S-phase kinase associated protein 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180175.name: usp-50
180175.summary: Predicted to enable cysteine-type deubiquitinase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein deubiquitination. Predicted to be located in early endosome. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in ACTH-secreting pituitary adenoma. Orthologous to several human genes including USP8 (ubiquitin specific peptidase 8). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180236.name: cyp-42A1
180236.summary: Predicted to enable several functions, including heme binding activity; iron ion binding activity; and monooxygenase activity. Predicted to be located in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Bietti crystalline corneoretinal dystrophy. Orthologous to human CYP4V2 (cytochrome P450 family 4 subfamily V member 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180262.name: Y39B6A.3
180262.summary: Predicted to enable 2 iron, 2 sulfur cluster binding activity. Predicted to be involved in iron-sulfur cluster assembly and protein maturation. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in multiple mitochondrial dysfunctions syndrome 5. Orthologous to human ISCA1 (iron-sulfur cluster assembly 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180311.name: unc-51
180311.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; nematode male tail tip morphogenesis; and regulation of axon extension. Located in axon and neuronal cell body. Is expressed in body wall musculature; neurons; and pharyngeal muscle cell. Orthologous to human ULK1 (unc-51 like autophagy activating kinase 1) and ULK2 (unc-51 like autophagy activating kinase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180313.name: ttx-1
180313.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity and RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; regulation of plasma membrane bounded cell projection assembly; and thermosensory behavior. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in head neurons and pharyngeal cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Leber congenital amaurosis 7; combined pituitary hormone deficiency 6; cone-rod dystrophy 2; and syndromic microphthalmia 5. Orthologous to several human genes including OTX1 (orthodenticle homeobox 1) and OTX2 (orthodenticle homeobox 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180344.name: B0250.5
180344.summary: Predicted to enable 3-hydroxyisobutyrate dehydrogenase activity. Predicted to be involved in L-valine catabolic process. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Orthologous to human HIBADH (3-hydroxyisobutyrate dehydrogenase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180357.name: pha-4
180357.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; nematode pharynx development; and regulation of gene expression. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including arcade cell; enteric muscle; gonad; pharynx; and rectum. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in breast cancer; gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); lung cancer (multiple); and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to human FOXA1 (forkhead box A1) and FOXA2 (forkhead box A2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180359.name: hif-1
180359.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity and RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to caloric restriction; determination of adult lifespan; and heat acclimation. Located in nucleus. Is expressed widely. Used to study cancer and cardiovascular system disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in artery disease (multiple); lung non-small cell carcinoma; polycythemia (multiple); prostate cancer; and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to human EPAS1 (endothelial PAS domain protein 1); HIF1A (hypoxia inducible factor 1 subunit alpha); and HIF3A (hypoxia inducible factor 3 subunit alpha). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180366.name: sbt-1
180366.summary: Enables peptidase activator activity and peptidase inhibitor activity. Involved in regulation of muscle contraction. Predicted to be located in extracellular region and secretory granule. Is expressed in neurons and pharynx. Orthologous to human SCG5 (secretogranin V). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180393.name: ife-2
180393.summary: Enables RNA 7-methylguanosine cap binding activity and RNA trimethylguanosine cap binding activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; negative regulation of response to oxidative stress; and positive regulation of translation. Located in cytoplasmic stress granule. Is expressed in several structures, including excretory canal; germ line; nerve ring; neurons; and vulva. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autistic disorder. Orthologous to human EIF4E (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4E) and EIF4E1B (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4E family member 1B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180398.name: dve-1
180398.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; enzyme binding activity; and protein-folding chaperone binding activity. Involved in embryo development; mitochondrial unfolded protein response; and regulation of innate immune response. Located in chromatin; cytosol; and nucleus. Part of transcription regulator complex. Is expressed in several structures, including arcade cell; intestine; midbody; nervous system; and rectum. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in SATB2-associated syndrome. Orthologous to human SATB1 (SATB homeobox 1) and SATB2 (SATB homeobox 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180401.name: che-2
180401.summary: Involved in several processes, including dauer larval development; negative regulation of transforming growth factor beta receptor signaling pathway; and positive regulation of locomotion involved in locomotory behavior. Located in ciliary basal body and non-motile cilium. Is expressed in neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in asphyxiating thoracic dystrophy 2. Orthologous to human IFT80 (intraflagellar transport 80). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180407.name: nas-38
180407.summary: Predicted to enable metalloendopeptidase activity. Involved in PERK-mediated unfolded protein response. Predicted to be active in extracellular region. Is expressed in hypodermis; rectal epithelium; reproductive system; seam cell; and vulva. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180431.name: daf-3
180431.summary: Enables cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including defense response to Gram-negative bacterium; determination of adult lifespan; and positive regulation of dauer larval development. Located in condensed chromosome; cytoplasm; and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including P1; P10; hermaphrodite distal tip cell; hypodermal cell; and neurons. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180446.name: arr-1
180446.summary: Predicted to enable G protein-coupled receptor binding activity. Involved in positive regulation of growth rate. Predicted to be located in dendrite and perikaryon. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including intestine; nervous system; pharynx; reproductive system; and tail. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in glioblastoma; myopia; nicotine dependence; opiate dependence (multiple); and retinal disease (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including ARRB1 (arrestin beta 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180475.name: pdk-1
180475.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to reactive oxygen species; dauer larval development; and regulation of synaptic assembly at neuromuscular junction. Located in axon; neuronal cell body; and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including gonad; intestine; neurons; pharynx; and ventral nerve cord. Used to study depressive disorder. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in prostate cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including PDPK1 (3-phosphoinositide dependent protein kinase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180527.name: gpa-5
180527.summary: Predicted to enable G protein-coupled receptor binding activity; G-protein beta/gamma-subunit complex binding activity; and GTPase activity. Predicted to be involved in adenylate cyclase-modulating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway. Located in axon; neuronal cell body; and synapse. Is expressed in amphid neurons. Orthologous to human GNAZ (G protein subunit alpha z). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180579.name: vang-1
180579.summary: Enables PDZ domain binding activity. Involved in Wnt signaling pathway, planar cell polarity pathway and digestive tract morphogenesis. Located in apical plasma membrane and basolateral plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including P5.ppp; P7.paa; egg-laying apparatus; gonad; and neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in caudal regression syndrome and neural tube defect. Orthologous to human VANGL1 (VANGL planar cell polarity protein 1) and VANGL2 (VANGL planar cell polarity protein 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180585.name: osm-5
180585.summary: Predicted to enable kinesin binding activity. Involved in several processes, including dauer entry; locomotory exploration behavior; and non-motile cilium assembly. Located in ciliary basal body; neuron projection; and non-motile cilium. Part of intraciliary transport particle B. Is expressed in amphid sensillum and neurons. Used to study autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease. Orthologous to human IFT88 (intraflagellar transport 88). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180601.name: gpd-3
180601.summary: Predicted to enable glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (NAD+) (phosphorylating) activity. Predicted to be involved in glycolytic process. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be active in cytosol. Is expressed in several structures, including gonad; intestine; and pharynx. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Alzheimer's disease. Orthologous to several human genes including GAPDH (glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180630.name: vit-5
180630.summary: Predicted to enable lipid carrier activity. Predicted to be involved in lipid transport. Predicted to be located in extracellular region. Is expressed in intestine. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180671.name: ceh-18
180671.summary: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; negative regulation of oocyte maturation; and ovulation. Acts upstream of or within with a positive effect on oocyte maturation. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in body wall musculature; gonad; neurons; non-striated muscle; and somatic nervous system. Orthologous to human POU2F1 (POU class 2 homeobox 1); POU2F2 (POU class 2 homeobox 2); and POU2F3 (POU class 2 homeobox 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180695.name: hpk-1
180695.summary: Predicted to enable protein serine/threonine kinase activity and protein tyrosine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including autophagosome assembly; determination of adult lifespan; and response to heat. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including gonad; hypodermal cell; intestine; neurons; and pharyngeal cell. Used to study Parkinson's disease and depressive disorder. Orthologous to several human genes including HIPK1 (homeodomain interacting protein kinase 1); HIPK2 (homeodomain interacting protein kinase 2); and HIPK3 (homeodomain interacting protein kinase 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180702.name: ets-9
180702.summary: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. Predicted to be involved in cell differentiation and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Orthologous to human ETV7 (ETS variant transcription factor 7). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180708.name: cst-1
180708.summary: Predicted to enable protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan and muscle cell development. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in hypodermis; sensory neurons; terminal bulb; and vulva. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in primary immunodeficiency disease. Orthologous to several human genes including STK3 (serine/threonine kinase 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180718.name: asb-2
180718.description: ATP synthase F(0) complex subunit B2, mitochondrial
180718.otherdesignations: ATP synthase F(0) complex subunit B2, mitochondrial
180718.nomenclaturename: ATP synthase F(0) complex subunit B2, mitochondrial
180718.summary: Predicted to enable proton transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to contribute to proton-transporting ATP synthase activity, rotational mechanism. Predicted to be involved in proton motive force-driven ATP synthesis. Predicted to be located in mitochondrion. Predicted to be active in mitochondrial inner membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including gonad. Orthologous to human ATP5PB (ATP synthase peripheral stalk-membrane subunit b). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180721.name: rhi-1
180721.summary: Predicted to enable Rho GDP-dissociation inhibitor activity. Predicted to be involved in Rho protein signal transduction. Located in cytosol and membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in nephrotic syndrome type 8. Orthologous to human ARHGDIA (Rho GDP dissociation inhibitor alpha); ARHGDIB (Rho GDP dissociation inhibitor beta); and ARHGDIG (Rho GDP dissociation inhibitor gamma). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180722.name: spr-3
180722.summary: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity and transcription cis-regulatory region binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Used to study Alzheimer's disease. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180740.name: tmem-135
180740.summary: Acts upstream of or within several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; positive regulation of lipid storage; and positive regulation of mitochondrial membrane potential. Located in cytoplasm and lipid droplet. Is expressed in epithelial system; hypodermis; intestine; and pharynx. Orthologous to human TMEM135 (transmembrane protein 135). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180752.name: npr-1
180752.summary: Enables neuropeptide receptor activity. Involved in several processes, including behavioral response to ethanol; social behavior; and thermotaxis. Located in several cellular components, including axon; dendrite; and neuronal cell body. Is expressed in excretory system; neurons; pharyngeal muscle cell; and preanal ganglion. Used to study alcohol use disorder. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hypertension. Orthologous to human PRLHR (prolactin releasing hormone receptor). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180757.name: R08E3.3
180757.summary: Predicted to enable cullin family protein binding activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Is expressed in anterior gonad arm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Ritscher-Schinzel syndrome 2. Orthologous to human CCDC22 (CCC complex scaffolding subunit CCDC22). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180769.name: calu-1
180769.summary: Enables calcium ion binding activity. Involved in cuticle development. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Is expressed in several structures, including AIA; hypodermis; intestine; pharynx; and reproductive system. Orthologous to several human genes including CALU (calumenin) and RCN1 (reticulocalbin 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180780.name: acn-1
180780.summary: Involved in ecdysis, collagen and cuticulin-based cuticle and nematode male tail tip morphogenesis. Acts upstream of or within with a negative effect on cell-cell fusion. Predicted to be located in membrane. Is expressed in excretory gland cell; hypodermis; vulva; and in male. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Coronavirus infectious disease (multiple); artery disease (multiple); heart valve disease (multiple); liver disease (multiple); and lung disease (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including ACE2 (angiotensin converting enzyme 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180781.name: vit-2
180781.summary: Predicted to enable lipid carrier activity. Predicted to be involved in lipid transport. Located in cytoplasmic vesicle; vesicle lumen; and yolk granule. Is expressed in embryonic cell; gonad; intestine; oocyte; and pseudocoelom. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180783.name: apl-1
180783.summary: Predicted to enable heparin binding activity and transition metal ion binding activity. Involved in body morphogenesis; ecdysis, collagen and cuticulin-based cuticle; and nematode larval development. Located in cytoplasmic vesicle; neuron projection; and neuronal cell body. Is expressed in several structures, including epithelial cell; excretory cell; hermaphrodite gonad; neurons; and somatic nervous system. Used to study Alzheimer's disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in APP-related cerebral amyloid angiopathy; Alzheimer's disease; Alzheimer's disease 1; cognitive disorder; and traumatic brain injury. Orthologous to several human genes including APLP2 (amyloid beta precursor like protein 2) and APP (amyloid beta precursor protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180784.name: tbc-7
180784.description: Rab-GAP TBC domain-containing protein;TLDc domain-containing protein
180784.otherdesignations: Rab-GAP TBC domain-containing protein;TLDc domain-containing protein
180784.nomenclaturename: Rab-GAP TBC domain-containing protein;TLDc domain-containing protein
180784.summary: Predicted to be located in cytoplasmic vesicle membrane; endomembrane system; and synapse. Is expressed in body wall musculature; head; intestine; and neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in DOORS syndrome; epilepsy (multiple); and nonsyndromic deafness (multiple). Orthologous to human TBC1D24 (TBC1 domain family member 24). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180808.name: pfn-2
180808.summary: Predicted to enable actin monomer binding activity. Involved in muscle thin filament assembly. Predicted to be located in cytoskeleton. Predicted to be active in cell cortex. Is expressed in intestine; neurons; pharynx; and spermatheca. Orthologous to human PFN4 (profilin family member 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180810.name: jkk-1
180810.description: Dual specificity mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase jkk-1
180810.otherdesignations: Dual specificity mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase jkk-1
180810.nomenclaturename: Dual specificity mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase jkk-1
180810.summary: Enables JUN kinase kinase activity. Involved in hyperosmotic response and locomotion. Located in axon; cytoplasm; and neuronal cell body. Is expressed in neurons. Used to study alcohol use disorder. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180821.name: bus-8B
180821.summary: Predicted to enable alpha-1,3-mannosyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in dolichol-linked oligosaccharide biosynthetic process. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in endomembrane system. Is expressed in seam cell. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180853.name: ctbp-1
180853.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity and transcription corepressor activity. Involved in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in hypodermis and nervous system. Used to study alcohol use disorder. Orthologous to human CTBP1 (C-terminal binding protein 1) and CTBP2 (C-terminal binding protein 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180862.name: R07E4.3
180862.summary: Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial electron transport, ubiquinol to cytochrome c. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Predicted to be part of respiratory chain complex III. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 4. Orthologous to human UQCRQ (ubiquinol-cytochrome c reductase complex III subunit VII). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180873.name: pak-1
180873.summary: Enables GTP binding activity and protein kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including gonad morphogenesis; hemidesmosome assembly; and inductive cell migration. Located in several cellular components, including axon; hemidesmosome; and neuronal cell body. Is expressed in several structures, including P5.p hermaphrodite; P6.p hermaphrodite; gonad; hypodermis; and neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in breast cancer; ductal carcinoma in situ; non-syndromic X-linked intellectual disability 30; renal cell carcinoma; and schizophrenia. Orthologous to human PAK1 (p21 (RAC1) activated kinase 1); PAK2 (p21 (RAC1) activated kinase 2); and PAK3 (p21 (RAC1) activated kinase 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180883.name: kynu-1
180883.summary: Predicted to enable kynureninase activity. Predicted to be involved in L-tryptophan catabolic process. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in E lineage cell and hypodermal cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hydroxykynureninuria. Orthologous to human KYNU (kynureninase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180884.name: nnt-1
180884.summary: Predicted to enable NADP binding activity. Predicted to be involved in NADPH regeneration. Located in mitochondrion. Is expressed in coelomocyte; hypodermis; intestine; nervous system; and pharyngeal-intestinal valve. Orthologous to human NNT (nicotinamide nucleotide transhydrogenase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180889.name: daf-9
180889.summary: Predicted to enable heme binding activity; oxidoreductase activity, acting on paired donors, with incorporation or reduction of molecular oxygen, reduced flavin or flavoprotein as one donor, and incorporation of one atom of oxygen; and steroid hydroxylase activity. Involved in cell-cell signaling; dauer larval development; and regulation of cell migration. Located in neuronal cell body and perinuclear region of cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior ganglion; excretory cell; intestine; spermatheca; and vulval muscle. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180919.name: pept-1
180919.summary: Enables dipeptide transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; positive regulation of growth rate; and regulation of intracellular signal transduction. Located in apical plasma membrane. Is expressed in intestine. Used to study obesity. Orthologous to human SLC15A1 (solute carrier family 15 member 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180927.name: ets-4
180927.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity; and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in positive regulation of axon extension involved in regeneration and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. Part of RNA polymerase II transcription regulator complex. Is expressed in several structures, including germ line; head; hypodermis; socket cell; and sperm. Orthologous to human SPDEF (SAM pointed domain containing ETS transcription factor). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180942.name: mdl-1
180942.summary: Enables protein heterodimerization activity. Contributes to sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan. Located in nucleus. Part of transcription regulator complex. Is expressed in several structures, including intestine; neurons; pharynx; somatic gonad precursor; and somatic nervous system. Used to study Parkinson's disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in neurofibrosarcoma and prostate cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including MXD1 (MAX dimerization protein 1); MXD4 (MAX dimerization protein 4); and MXI1 (MAX interactor 1, dimerization protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

180956.name: asg-2
180956.description: putative ATP synthase subunit g 2, mitochondrial
180956.otherdesignations: putative ATP synthase subunit g 2, mitochondrial
180956.nomenclaturename: putative ATP synthase subunit g 2, mitochondrial
180956.summary: Predicted to enable proton transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to contribute to proton-transporting ATP synthase activity, rotational mechanism. Predicted to be involved in proton motive force-driven ATP synthesis. Located in mitochondrion and non-motile cilium. Orthologous to several human genes including ATP5MG (ATP synthase membrane subunit g). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180982.name: bar-1
180982.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity and transcription coactivator activity. Involved in several processes, including Ras protein signal transduction; determination of adult lifespan; and nematode larval development. Located in several cellular components, including adherens junction; cytosol; and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including egg-laying apparatus; gonad; and intestine. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

180990.name: unc-10
180990.summary: Enables small GTPase binding activity. Involved in several processes, including chemical synaptic transmission; defecation; and positive regulation of cholinergic synaptic transmission. Located in axon and presynaptic active zone. Is expressed in nervous system and uv1. Orthologous to several human genes including RIMS1 (regulating synaptic membrane exocytosis 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

181019.name: apy-1
181019.summary: Enables GDP phosphatase activity and UDP phosphatase activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; endoplasmic reticulum unfolded protein response; and ribonucleoside diphosphate catabolic process. Located in membrane. Is expressed in hypodermis and pharynx. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Desbuquois dysplasia and multiple epiphyseal dysplasia 7. Orthologous to human CANT1 (calcium activated nucleotidase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

181034.name: vit-1
181034.summary: Predicted to enable lipid carrier activity. Predicted to be involved in lipid transport. Predicted to be located in extracellular region. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

181055.name: sem-5
181055.summary: Enables epidermal growth factor receptor binding activity. Involved in several processes, including epidermal growth factor receptor signaling pathway; male genitalia development; and regulation of vulval development. Predicted to be part of COP9 signalosome. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm; nucleoplasm; and plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including P3.p hermaphrodite; P4.p hermaphrodite; P5.p hermaphrodite; P6.p hermaphrodite; and P7.p hermaphrodite. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive nonsyndromic deafness 114; breast cancer; prostate adenocarcinoma; and prostate cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including GRB2 (growth factor receptor bound protein 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

181057.name: his-71
181057.summary: Predicted to enable nucleosomal DNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of chromatin. Predicted to be involved in heterochromatin formation; kinetochore assembly; and mitotic metaphase chromosome alignment. Predicted to be located in chromatin. Predicted to be part of nucleosome. Predicted to be active in kinetochore and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including intestine and nervous system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Bryant-Li-Bhoj neurodevelopmental syndrome 1 and Bryant-Li-Bhoj neurodevelopmental syndrome 2. Orthologous to several human genes including H3-3A (H3.3 histone A) and H3-3B (H3.3 histone B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

181102.name: nhr-14
181102.description: Nuclear hormone receptor family member nhr-14
181102.otherdesignations: Nuclear hormone receptor family member nhr-14
181102.nomenclaturename: Nuclear hormone receptor family member nhr-14
181102.summary: Enables steroid hormone binding activity. Involved in defense response to Gram-negative bacterium; negative regulation of protein localization to nucleus; and regulation of innate immune response. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in head and intestinal cell. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

181110.name: utx-1
181110.summary: Predicted to enable RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity; chromatin DNA binding activity; and histone H3K27me2/H3K27me3 demethylase activity. Involved in cell fate specification and programmed cell death. Part of MLL3/4 complex. Is expressed in several structures, including germ line; gonad; intestine; pharynx; and tail. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Kabuki syndrome; Stolerman neurodevelopmental syndrome; gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); lung carcinoma (multiple); and triple-receptor negative breast cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including KDM6A (lysine demethylase 6A) and UTY (ubiquitously transcribed tetratricopeptide repeat containing, Y-linked). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

181174.name: nuc-1
181174.summary: Enables deoxyribonuclease II activity. Involved in apoptotic DNA fragmentation. Acts upstream of or within with a positive effect on negative regulation of antimicrobial peptide production. Located in lysosome. Is expressed in body wall musculature; head; intestinal cell; and vulva. Orthologous to human DNASE2B (deoxyribonuclease 2 beta) and DNASE2 (deoxyribonuclease 2, lysosomal). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

181182.name: ifp-1
181182.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of cytoskeleton. Predicted to be involved in several processes, including heterochromatin formation; nucleus organization; and protein localization to nuclear envelope. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be active in nuclear lamina. Is expressed in head; head neurons; intestine; pharynx; and ventral nerve cord. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

181214.name: F42G10.1
181214.summary: Predicted to enable metalloendopeptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein processing. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

181215.name: cbs-1
181215.summary: Enables cystathionine beta-synthase activity; cysteine synthase activity; and pyridoxal phosphate binding activity. Involved in sulfur compound biosynthetic process. Located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in body wall musculature; hypodermis; intestine; pharyngeal muscle cell; and reproductive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including cerebral infarction; homocystinuria; hyperhomocysteinemia; malaria; and neural tube defect. Orthologous to human CBS (cystathionine beta-synthase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

181255.name: syd-2
181255.summary: Enables several functions, including cytoskeletal motor activator activity; kinesin binding activity; and protein homodimerization activity. Involved in several processes, including anterograde synaptic vesicle transport; egg-laying behavior; and positive regulation of anterograde synaptic vesicle transport. Located in axon; cytoplasm; and presynaptic active zone dense projection. Is expressed in several structures, including excretory gland cell; nervous system; pharyngeal gland cell; rectal gland cell; and uv1. Orthologous to several human genes including PPFIA1 (PPFI scaffold protein A1) and PPFIA3 (PPFI scaffold protein A3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

181263.name: daf-12
181263.description: Nuclear hormone receptor HR3;Nuclear hormone receptor family member daf-12
181263.otherdesignations: Nuclear hormone receptor HR3;Nuclear hormone receptor family member daf-12
181263.nomenclaturename: Nuclear hormone receptor HR3;Nuclear hormone receptor family member daf-12
181263.summary: Enables nuclear receptor activity; sequence-specific DNA binding activity; and steroid hormone binding activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; heat acclimation; and positive regulation of dauer larval development. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including gonad; nervous system; pharyngeal muscle cell; somatic gonad precursor; and vulva. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including bone disease (multiple); carcinoma (multiple); liver disease (multiple); lung disease (multiple); and melanoma (multiple). Orthologous to human VDR (vitamin D receptor). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

181292.name: ldb-1
181292.description: LIM domain-binding protein 1;LIM interaction domain-containing protein
181292.otherdesignations: LIM domain-binding protein 1;LIM interaction domain-containing protein
181292.nomenclaturename: LIM domain-binding protein 1;LIM interaction domain-containing protein
181292.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity; DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity; and LIM domain binding activity. Involved in several processes, including mechanosensory behavior; positive regulation of vulval development; and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be part of transcription regulator complex. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including egg-laying apparatus; gonad; head neurons; ray neurons; and tail neurons. Orthologous to several human genes including LDB1 (LIM domain binding 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

181297.name: lpr-5
181297.summary: Is expressed in several structures, including seam cell. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

181321.name: vhl-1
181321.summary: Predicted to enable transcription corepressor activity and ubiquitin-like ligase-substrate adaptor activity. Involved in response to hypoxia. Part of Cul2-RING ubiquitin ligase complex. Is expressed in several structures, including ADFL and ADFR. Used to study clear cell renal cell carcinoma and von Hippel-Lindau disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including pancreatic cancer (multiple); pheochromocytoma; polycythemia (multiple); renal cell carcinoma; and von Hippel-Lindau disease. Orthologous to human VHL (von Hippel-Lindau tumor suppressor). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

181337.name: lin-14
181337.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity and single-stranded DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; regulation of cell fate specification; and regulation of nematode larval development, heterochronic. Located in condensed nuclear chromosome. Is expressed in several structures, including P3.p hermaphrodite; neurons; oocyte; seam cell; and somatic nervous system. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

181348.name: ftt-2
181348.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity and protein sequestering activity. Involved in dauer larval development and negative regulation of protein import into nucleus. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including AB; C; E; EMS; and gonad. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 56; transitional cell carcinoma; and vulva squamous cell carcinoma. Orthologous to several human genes including YWHAB (tyrosine 3-monooxygenase/tryptophan 5-monooxygenase activation protein beta) and YWHAZ (tyrosine 3-monooxygenase/tryptophan 5-monooxygenase activation protein zeta). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

181357.name: ttx-3
181357.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including olfactory learning; positive regulation of dauer larval development; and thermosensory behavior. Predicted to be located in axon and perikaryon. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in head muscle; head neurons; and pharyngeal neurons. Used to study depressive disorder. Orthologous to several human genes including LHX9 (LIM homeobox 9). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

181362.name: mes-1
181362.summary: Predicted to enable protein serine/threonine kinase activity and protein tyrosine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including asymmetric protein localization involved in cell fate determination; establishment of mitotic spindle localization; and left/right axis specification. Located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in E; Psub2; Psub3; Psub4; and germ line. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

181370.name: sams-1
181370.summary: Enables methionine adenosyltransferase activity. Involved in S-adenosylmethionine biosynthetic process and negative regulation of lipid storage. Predicted to be active in cytosol. Is expressed in body wall musculature; dorsal nerve cord; and ventral nerve cord. Used to study lipid metabolism disorder. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hypermethioninemia and lung cancer. Orthologous to human MAT1A (methionine adenosyltransferase 1A) and MAT2A (methionine adenosyltransferase 2A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

181371.name: set-6
181371.summary: Enables histone H3K9 dimethyltransferase activity and histone H3K9 trimethyltransferase activity. Involved in epigenetic regulation of gene expression. Located in chromatin. Is expressed in embryonic cell; gonad; muscle cell; nervous system; and sperm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

181400.name: lin-2
181400.summary: Enables insulin-like growth factor receptor binding activity. Involved in several processes, including egg-laying behavior; gamma-aminobutyric acid receptor clustering; and positive regulation of vulval development. Located in cell junction. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; isthmus; neurons; somatic nervous system; and vulval precursor cell. Used to study autism spectrum disorder. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in FG syndrome and syndromic X-linked intellectual disability Najm type. Orthologous to several human genes including CASK (calcium/calmodulin dependent serine protein kinase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

181403.name: odr-7
181403.description: Nuclear hormone receptor family member odr-7
181403.otherdesignations: Nuclear hormone receptor family member odr-7
181403.nomenclaturename: Nuclear hormone receptor family member odr-7
181403.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. Involved in negative adaptation of signaling pathway; positive chemotaxis; and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in AWAL and AWAR. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

181405.name: atf-6
181405.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in ATF6-mediated unfolded protein response and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including intestine; muscle cell; pharyngeal gland cell; rectum; and vulva. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in achromatopsia 7. Orthologous to human ATF6 (activating transcription factor 6) and ATF6B (activating transcription factor 6 beta). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

181423.name: bcat-1
181423.summary: Predicted to enable L-isoleucine:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity; L-leucine:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity; and L-valine:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity. Involved in branched-chain amino acid catabolic process; embryo development; and nematode larval development. Acts upstream of or within determination of adult lifespan. Located in mitochondrion. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; intestine; nervous system; pharynx; and reproductive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hypervalinemia and hyperleucine-isoleucinemia. Orthologous to human BCAT1 (branched chain amino acid transaminase 1) and BCAT2 (branched chain amino acid transaminase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

181424.name: gpc-1
181424.summary: Predicted to enable G-protein beta-subunit binding activity. Involved in sensory perception of taste. Predicted to be located in plasma membrane. Predicted to be part of heterotrimeric G-protein complex. Is expressed in head mesodermal cell; intestine; and nervous system. Orthologous to several human genes including GNG7 (G protein subunit gamma 7). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

181432.name: nhr-25
181432.description: Nuclear hormone receptor family member nhr-25
181432.otherdesignations: Nuclear hormone receptor family member nhr-25
181432.nomenclaturename: Nuclear hormone receptor family member nhr-25
181432.summary: Enables armadillo repeat domain binding activity. Involved in molting cycle and positive regulation of nematode male tail tip morphogenesis. Acts upstream of or within positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including excretory system; gonad; hypodermis; somatic gonad precursor; and vulval precursor cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in 46,XX sex reversal 4; 46,XY sex reversal 3; Zellweger syndrome; primary ovarian insufficiency 7; and spermatogenic failure 8. Orthologous to several human genes including NR5A2 (nuclear receptor subfamily 5 group A member 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

181442.name: gpa-6
181442.summary: Predicted to enable G protein-coupled receptor binding activity; G-protein beta/gamma-subunit complex binding activity; and GTPase activity. Predicted to be involved in adenylate cyclase-modulating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway. Located in axon and neuronal cell body. Is expressed in head mesodermal cell; intestine; and nervous system. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

181462.name: cyp-13B1
181462.summary: Predicted to enable several functions, including heme binding activity; iron ion binding activity; and monooxygenase activity. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Ghosal hematodiaphyseal syndrome; cerebral infarction; essential hypertension; familial Mediterranean fever; and leukemia (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including CYP3A7-CYP3A51P (CYP3A7-CYP3A51P readthrough); CYP3A4 (cytochrome P450 family 3 subfamily A member 4); and CYP3A43 (cytochrome P450 family 3 subfamily A member 43). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

181473.name: pab-2
181473.summary: Predicted to enable mRNA 3'-UTR binding activity; poly(A) binding activity; and poly(U) RNA binding activity. Located in cytoplasm. Orthologous to several human genes including PABPC1 (poly(A) binding protein cytoplasmic 1) and PABPC3 (poly(A) binding protein cytoplasmic 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

181481.name: bra-1
181481.summary: Enables signaling receptor binding activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan and negative regulation of transforming growth factor beta receptor signaling pathway. Located in axon and dendrite. Is expressed in neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 30. Orthologous to several human genes including ZMYND11 (zinc finger MYND-type containing 11). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

181492.name: aakb-1
181492.summary: Predicted to enable protein kinase binding activity. Predicted to be involved in signal transduction. Predicted to be part of nucleotide-activated protein kinase complex. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including egg-laying apparatus; neurons; pharynx; rectal valve cell; and tail hypodermis. Orthologous to human PRKAB1 (protein kinase AMP-activated non-catalytic subunit beta 1) and PRKAB2 (protein kinase AMP-activated non-catalytic subunit beta 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]
